gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.004016 40.749949)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.004016 40.749949)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.691404 39.316489)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.691404 39.316489)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ABS(p1.elev - p2.elev) AS elevation_difference_m,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH points_of_interest AS (
  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.004016, 40.749949), 4326)::geometry AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-78.691404, 39.316489), 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    ST_Value(r.rast, p.geom) AS elevation
  FROM 
    points_of_interest p
  JOIN 
    public.dem_us r
  ON 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geom)
)
SELECT 
  ABS(e1.elevation - e2.elevation) AS elevation_gap
FROM 
  elevation_values e1
JOIN 
  elevation_values e2
ON 
  e1.id = '[3]' AND e2.id = '[4]';
